o: „Aha,“ děl Jensen.

t: You should have seen how the old man went wild; he turned blue, grabbed me by the neck and would have thrown me into the water, if it hadn't been for Mate Gregory there. You know him?”

o: Švéd jenom pokývl.

t: He stops at some godforsaken islet, rows along the shore in a boat and takes soundings; then he moors by those tanks, opens the hatch in the ship's side and lets those wretches into the water.

o: Člověče, to ti skáče tím okénkem jedno po druhém jako cvičení tuleni, vždycky deset nebo dvanáct – A v noci pak jede starý Toch na břeh s nějakými bedničkami.

t: But wait, so you'll trust me — I'll give you a note of debt for those twelve francs, won't I?"

t: And Mr. Dingle slowly wrote, protruding his tongue and moistening the pencil with the effort.

o: Stvrzenka stvrzuju timto žesem ot Jen Jensena přijal namši za Duši Captna Tocha dva 12 franku Pat Dingle.
t: Receipt confirmed by this seal: Father Jen Jensen accepted the mass for the soul of Capt. Toch, twelve francs, Pat Dingle.

o: „Je to tak dobře?“ ptal se pan Dingle nejistě.
t: "Is that all right?" asked Mr. Dingle uncertainly.

o: „A kdo z nás má tu listinu nechat u sebe?“
t: "And which of us is to keep the document?"

o: „Přece ty, ty vole,“ řekl Švéd samozřejmě.
t: "You, of course, you bastard," said the Swede matter-of-factly.

o: „To je proto, aby člověk nezapomněl, že dostal peníze.“
t: "That's so a person doesn't forget that he was given money."

o: Těch dvanáct franků pan Dingle propil v Havru a mimoto místo do Irska jel do Džibuti; zkrátka ta mše sloužena nebyla, následkem čehož do přirozeného průběhu věcí nezasáhla žádná vyšší moc.
t: Mr Dingle squandered those twelve francs in Le Havre and instead of going on to Ireland he went to Djibouti; in short, the mass was not said, and consequently no higher power intervened in the natural course of things.
